(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a forward section __constructed from a reinforced open rib structure__; and an aero cover carried on said body panel and spanning said open rib structure.

(Currently Amended) Claim 15: A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a first corner buttress, a second corner buttress, a first open rib structure reinforcing said first corner buttress __with a fore-aft rib and transverse ribs__ and a second open rib structure reinforcing said second corner buttress __with a fore-aft rib and transverse ribs__; a first aero cover spanning and closing said first open rib structure; and a second aero cover spanning and closing said second open rib structure.
